targets.title: Do defaults save lives?.lives?
targets.evidence_quote: We selected Johnson and Goldstein (2003) and Johnson et al. (2002) as our replication targets for three reasons: each is foundational, has been highly influential in academia (Kahneman, 2003;Kruglanski & Gigerenzer, 2011;Weber & Johnson, 2009), and has been highly influential in practice for policymaking.
targets.outcome_quote: Our replication results are consistent with Johnson and Goldstein (2003)-though the effects were smaller than those reported in the original study.
